google_organic_live_advanced.description: Real-time Google SERP scraping with full SERP features: AI Overviews, People Also Ask, Featured Snippets, Knowledge Graph, Top Stories, Local Pack.

google_organic_task_post.description: Standard asynchronous Google SERP task (70% cheaper than live). Requires webhook or polling.

keyword_suggestions_live.description: Returns search volume, CPC, competition, keyword difficulty, and monthly trend data for relevant keyword variations.

search_intent_live.description: Classifies a list of keywords by search intent: informational, navigational, commercial, transactional, with confidence scores.

ranked_keywords_live.description: Returns keywords that a specific competitor domain ranks for in Google.

historical_serps_live.description: Historical rankings and volatility for a keyword over time.

summary_live.description: Domain rank, referring domains, backlink counts, and toxic link distribution for a target URL or domain.

instant_pages.description: Instant single-page audit: title, description, h1-h6 tags, word count, schema/microdata, broken links.

user_data.description: Returns account balance, limits, and rates. Free call.
